newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: DCB gets okay to talk on revamp - report.
newsitem.headline: DCB gets okay to talk on revamp - report.

text.p: DCB Holdings Bhd has received permission from the central bank to begin talks with its parent company, Rashid Hussain Bhd, on a revamp involving itself and another bank, The Star said on Friday.
Quoting a DCB statement, the report said the negotiations are subject to Rashid's success in acquiring a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik Bank Bhd.
Stockbroker Rashid said last week it has received approval from the central bank to negotiate buying a 75 percent stake in Kwong Yik from Malayan Banking Bhd.
Rashid is widely expected to inject Kwong Yik into financial group DCB as part of a restructuring to create a larger financial institution.
Rashid owns a 20.4 percent stake in DCB.
Shares of DCB, Rashid, Kwong Yik and Malayan Banking have been suspended since Oct 21. Officials at DCB could not be immediately contacted for comment.
